## ANTI-AI-SLOP
The visual results of the 'densification' are good, but the implementation introduces architectural debt by bypassing the layout primitives system. Creating a new `DenseGrid.tsx` for a specific configuration of columns and gaps creates exactly the kind of fragmentation the primitives system is designed to prevent.

## FINDINGS
- `src/components/ui/DenseGrid.tsx`: Redundant component. Layout logic should be handled by the `<Grid />` primitive.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: Violation of Rule 12 (Composition Over Configuration) and Rule 3 (Primitives for Layout): This component is redundant. Use the `<Grid />` primitive with responsive `cols` and `gap` props instead of creating a new one-off wrapper.
